Get distinct values for a custom tag key from the query_tag JSON column.

This endpoint extracts distinct values for a specified JSON key from the query_tag
column in the query usage data. It supports optional search filtering and pagination.

Use cases:
- Get all distinct values for 'dbt_snowflake_query_tags_version'
- Get distinct values matching a search pattern (e.g., values starting with '2.5')
- Retrieve entities/values for a custom tag key for filtering purposes

Example usage:
- GET /filters/custom-tag-values/?tag_key=dbt_snowflake_query_tags_version
- GET /filters/custom-tag-values/?tag_key=dbt_snowflake_query_tags_version&search=2.5
- GET /filters/custom-tag-values/?tag_key=project_name&prefix=custom_tags

query.description: (Required) The JSON key to extract values from query_tag

Bulk bounded-facet filters (AI-6471).

Returns the small/bounded filter facets in one call. Unbounded facets
are served from per-facet paginated endpoints — call those separately
when the user opens the corresponding dropdown:

  - /snowflake_jobs/filters/workflow_ids               (CUSTOM, DBT)
  - /snowflake_jobs/filters/workflow_ids_with_labels   (TABLEAU)
  - /snowflake_jobs/filters/teams                      (CUSTOM)
  - /snowflake_jobs/filters/apps                       (CUSTOM)
  - /snowflake_jobs/filters/custom_tags/{tag_key}

Behavior by workflow_type:
  - CUSTOM:        warehouses, custom_tag_keys
  - TABLEAU:       warehouses, teams, apps
  - DBT:           warehouses, integration_names, integration_environments,
                   integrations_with_environments
  - None (omitted): warehouses only; all workflow_type-scoped fields
                   are empty. Useful for screens that don't pin a
                   workflow_type yet but need the warehouse picker.
